title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX officially acquires Elon Musk’s xAI, with plan to build data centers in space
description: The merger creates the world's most valuable private company and paves the way for Musk to try and prove out the usefulness of space-based data centers.
author: Sean O'Kane

title: What Snowflake’s deal with OpenAI tells us about the enterprise AI race
description: Snowflake is the latest enterprise to sign multi-year deals with multiple AI companies in what could be a sign to come of a future trend.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
description: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.
author: Aisha Malik

title: OpenAI launches new macOS app for agentic coding
description: OpenAI has released a new macOS app for Codex, integrating many of the agentic coding practices that have become popular since Codex launched last year.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Ring brings its ‘Search Party’ feature for finding lost dogs to non-Ring camera owners
description: Ring's Search Party feature for finding lost dogs is now available across the U.S. — even if you don't own a Ring camera.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Coalition demands federal Grok ban over nonconsensual sexual content
description: Nonprofits urge the U.S. government to suspend Grok in federal agencies after the xAI chatbot generated thousands of nonconsensual sexual images, raising national security and child safety concerns.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Carbon Robotics built an AI model that detects and identifies plants
description: Carbon Robotics' Large Plant Model will allow farmers to kill new types of weeds without having to retrain the machines.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Linq raises $20M to enable AI assistants to live within messaging apps
description: Linq offers an API that lets  companies offer their AI assistants via iMessage, RCS and SMS.
author: Ram Iyer

title: These AI notetaking devices can help you record and transcribe your meetings
description: These physical notetakers transcribe audio and give users summaries and action items of meetings using AI. Some even offer live translation.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: AI layoffs or ‘AI-washing’?
description: How many of the companies with recent layoffs are just using AI as an excuse?
author: Anthony Ha

title: Why Tether’s CEO is everywhere right now
description: For years, Tether's CEO avoided the United States, watching from offshore as regulators circled and prosecutors investigated. Those days are over.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Indonesia ‘conditionally’ lifts ban on Grok
description: Indonesia has followed Malaysia and the Philippines in lifting a ban on xAI’s chatbot Grok.
author: Anthony Ha

title: India offers zero taxes through 2047 to lure global AI workloads
description: New Delhi's latest move comes as Amazon, Google, and Microsoft expand data center investments in India.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Bye-bye corporate conglomerates. Hello personal conglomerates.
description: Elon Musk's reported merging of SpaceX, xAI, and Tesla harkens back to the heyday of General Electric — or maybe the robber barons of the Gilded Age.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Nvidia CEO pushes back against report that his company’s $100B OpenAI investment has stalled
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that a recent report of friction between his company and OpenAI was “nonsense.”
author: Anthony Ha

title: A peek inside Physical Intelligence, the startup building Silicon Valley’s buzziest robot brains
description: If co-founder Lachy Groom has any doubts, he doesn’t show it. He’s working with people who've been working on this problem for decades and who believe the timing is finally right, which is all he needs to know.
author: Connie Loizos

title: OpenClaw’s AI assistants are now building their own social network
description: The viral personal AI assistant formerly known as Clawdbot has a new shell — again. After briefly rebranding as Moltbot, it has now picked OpenClaw as its new name.
author: Anna Heim

title: Anthropic brings agentic plug-ins to Cowork
description: The company says you can use plug-ins to "tell Claude how you like work done, which tools and data to pull from, how to handle critical workflows, and what slash commands to expose so your team gets more consistent outcomes."
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Last 24 hours to grab your plus-one pass at 50% off to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Today is the last day to lock in a plus-one pass at 50% off to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, happening on October 13-15 in San Francisco.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Guys, I don’t think Tim Cook knows how to monetize AI
description: One intrepid Morgan Stanley analyst dared to ask how Apple will make money on its AI investments. The answer will not shock you.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI in talks to merge, according to reports
description: This merger would bring the Grok chatbot, Starlink satellites, and SpaceX rockets together under one corporation.
author: Amanda Silberling, Kirsten Korosec

title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to invest $50B in OpenAI
description: If a deal materializes, it would mean Amazon is backing competing startups in the race for AI supremacy.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Satya Nadella insists people are using Microsoft’s Copilot AI a lot
description: With Microsoft spending many billions on data centers, and rumors that no one is using its AI, CEO Satya Nadella shared some usage numbers.
author: Julie Bort

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX and xAI in talks to merge, report says
description: This merger would bring the Grok chatbot, Starlink satellites, and SpaceX rockets together under one corporation.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Apple buys Israeli startup Q.ai as the AI race heats up
description: Q.ai is an Israeli startup specializing in imaging and machine learning, particularly technologies that enable devices to interpret whispered speech and enhance audio in noisy environments.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: I built marshmallow castles in Google’s new AI-world generator
description: Starting Thursday, Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S. can play around with Project Genie, which is powered by a combination of Google’s latest world model Genie 3, its image generation model Nano Banana Pro, and Gemini.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI’s Sora app is struggling after its stellar launch
description: New data suggests the app is seeing declines in both app downloads and consumer spending, as the early hype about the AI video social network wears off.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Music publishers sue Anthropic for $3B over ‘flagrant piracy’ of 20,000 works
description: Originally, these music publishers had filed a lawsuit against Anthropic over its use of about 500 copyrighted works.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: India is teaching Google how AI in education can scale
description: With the highest global usage of Gemini for learning, India is emerging as a key market shaping Google's approach to AI in education.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Flapping Airplanes and the promise of research-driven AI
description: A new AI lab called Flapping Airplanes launched yesterday, and a Sequoia partner has an interesting take on why they stand out.
author: Russell Brandom
